field_checks.summary: Table 1 MIC, MBC, MBIC, hemolytic concentration, and RAW 264.7 IC50 rows are source-aligned, but accepted activity coverage omits body Figure 1, Figure 2, and Figure 3 evidence: final activity_records contain only MIC/MBC/MBIC, no source figure locators, no accepted time-kill rows, and no accepted in vivo wound-infection rows. The source records BotrAMP14 complete eradication at 4 min, CrotAMP14 at 20 min, and in vivo bacterial-load outcomes at 24 h/48 h.

All 42 final database record audits were reviewed. They are all unresolved_record, source_verified is zero, no plain one-letter sequence/sequence_length object is present, and authoritative ingest flags remain false. This is boundary-preserving because the current primary source states the complete peptide sequences are in earlier publications and local authoritative DBAASP/merged linked rows are absent; it is not authoritative ingest-ready.

Paper and packet final mirrors are byte-identical for database, activity/toxicity, materials, mechanism_ontology, and review_report; packet mechanism_evidence.json is byte-identical to mechanism_ontology_record.json. Final review counts match current finals: 32 activity, 32 toxicity, 42 database audits, 3 mechanism claims, and live open rework tickets are 0. Caution: final materials_manifest still carries analysis_queue_status=analysis_queued while packet_manifest and analysis_status show analysis_source_reviewed_accepted.

Mechanism claims preserve ontology boundaries: 3 claims total, direct_mechanism count is 0, reference-only SEM context remains inferred_mechanism, primary MIC/MBIC/time-kill/toxicity/in vivo outcomes are not promoted to direct mechanism, and all mechanism claims have claim_id, claim_text, evidence_class, and source locators.

Paper identity is source-consistent for PMCID PMC12837634, PMID 41594114, DOI 10.3390/antibiotics15010077, title, journal, and 2026 publication metadata. Peptide names and masses are present, but primary sequences are explicitly deferred to earlier publications; all 42 database candidates remain unresolved and there are no linked authoritative rows. Source strain labels are inconsistent across surfaces: Table/Figures 1-2 use 003321216, while multiple result/method/in vivo statements use 00332121.

Exact Table 1 normalization is sound and Supplementary Figure S1 values retain approximate status, but provenance is not publication-grade: final toxicity records cite 27 distinct supp: locators while packet locator_index contains zero supp: locators, and final time-kill candidates are retained only as machine candidates with empty source_locator_candidates despite source XML/Figure locators being available.

Recursive authority boundary is false and fallback release boundary is preserved: authoritative_dbaasp_ingest_ready and authoritative_ingest_ready are false, all 42 fallback rows are candidate-only unresolved_record, source_verified count is 0, and the strict acceptance artifact explicitly says paper-level evidence must not promote fallback rows without authoritative links.

Current cautions preserve absent authoritative DBAASP links and approximate Supplementary Figure S1 values, but they do not preserve the paper-local strain-label conflict or the omission/exclusion status of Figures 1-3 activity evidence. Source surfaces mix A. baumannii 003321216 and 00332121 for the same study context, and the accepted final review has no caution/rework target for that conflict.

The sole staged supplement zip and recovered one-page PDF were independently inspected and contain Supplementary Figure S1 only, but packet material integration is incomplete for publication-grade provenance: supplementary_text.jsonl and supplementary_tables.json are empty and locator_index has no supp: locator entries even though final toxicity records depend on Supplementary Figure S1 point locators.

Toxicity/selectivity values in Table 1 are covered as 4 hemolytic-activity concentration records and 4 RAW 264.7 IC50 cytotoxicity records, and Supplementary Figure S1 is represented by 24 approximate percent-hemolysis records with approximate status preserved. Caution remains because the Supplementary Figure S1 final locators are not present in packet locator_index.
